fluff.overview: The Lyran Commonwealth's industrial wealth ensures its infantry are among the best-equipped in the Inner Sphere, fielding hardware that most armies reserve for elite formations as standard issue. Jump infantry use thruster backpacks to leap across obstacles and reposition rapidly on the battlefield, trading platoon size for the tactical mobility to seize or defend terrain that foot troops cannot reach quickly. Armed with standard assault rifles and supplemented by man-portable flamers, these platoons can both engage enemy personnel at range and deny terrain or flush defenders from cover with incendiary fire.
